steps.en: Clone, create a Python 3.8 env, install requirements plus GroundingDINO and segment-anything
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，建 Python 3.8 环境，装好全部依赖

steps.en: Export your OpenAI key for the controller LLM
steps.zh: 导出 OpenAI key，给充当调度者的 LLM 用

steps.en: Start it, naming which visual models load on which device
steps.zh: 启动它，指定哪些视觉模型加载到哪块设备

steps.en: Loads those models as LangChain tools and opens a Gradio chat page
steps.zh: 把这些模型注册成 LangChain 工具，打开 Gradio 聊天页

steps.en: Upload an image and ask for something in plain words
steps.zh: 上传一张图，用大白话提要求

steps.en: The LLM reads the tool list, picks a model, runs it, and saves the result as image/xxx.png
steps.zh: LLM 读工具清单、选模型、运行，把结果存成 image/xxx.png

steps.en: Replies in words with the new image threaded back into the chat
steps.zh: 用文字回复，把新图接回对话里

value.en: A text-only chatbot that can see and edit images by delegating to specialist vision models
value.zh: 只懂文字的聊天模型，借专业视觉模型之手也能看图、改图

sources: https://github.com/chenfei-wu/TaskMatrix#quick-start (conda create -n visgpt python=3.8, pip install -r requirements.txt, GroundingDINO / segment-anything installs, export OPENAI_API_KEY={Your_Private_Openai_Key}, python visual_chatgpt.py --load "ImageCaptioning_cuda:0,Text2Image_cuda:0")

https://github.com/chenfei-wu/TaskMatrix/blob/main/visual_chatgpt.py (import gradio, langchain initialize_agent / Tool, OpenAI(temperature=0), prefix prompt: each image has a file name formed as "image/xxx.png")
